title: Parse the public feedback form
prompt: Implement `parse_feedback(raw_body)` in feedback/api.py. It takes the raw JSON body of a POST from our public feedback form and returns {'rating': int, 'comment': str}. Ratings are whole numbers from 1 to 5, and the comment is optional (default ''). Anything else should raise ValueError, so the web layer can answer 400.
notes: Validation at a trust boundary (CWE-20). Type checks on the parsed JSON. The lazy-wrong version trusts the shape and crashes with TypeError on null, or accepts a rating of 9.
extension: Comments longer than 500 characters should be refused too.
